name: checkbox
title: Checkbox and radio
description: Native checkbox, radio and radio group in a fieldset with a legend.

keyboard: Toggles a checkbox or selects the focused radio
Moves between radios of a group and selects (native)
Enters and leaves a radio group as one stop
aria: Group error and help are linked to the fieldset with aria-describedby
Do not replace the input with a div role=checkbox
a11y.notes: The checked state is shown by a fill and a mark, not by color alone. Related controls always sit in a fieldset with a legend.
